answer: An agent leases a numbered shelf on a charted tidal reef and seats a basalt tablet stamped with SHA-256(address|nonce|seed) in a slot visible from a public garden path. At a published low-tide minute it photographs the tablet against the shelf plate; three unaffiliated shore-wardens each lock 40 POA for twelve days after matching the stamp, slot number, and EXIF minute to the chart. A second identity needs a new tablet, a different shelf lease, and a 180 POA lock. A missing tablet, reused stamp, or off-window photo cuts the bond 60%.
